@component
def Quiz():
    answers, set_answers = use_state({})
    errors, set_errors = use_state([])
    submitted, set_submitted = use_state(False)
    crashed, set_crashed = use_state(False)
    if crashed:
        _crash("quiz dev crash")

    def _val(qid):
        return answers[qid] if qid in answers else None

    def _set_radio(qid, opt):
        set_answers({**answers, qid: opt})

    def _toggle_check(qid, opt):
        cur = _val(qid) if _val(qid) is not None else []
        if opt in cur:
            nxt = [o for o in cur if o != opt]
        else:
            nxt = cur + [opt]
        set_answers({**answers, qid: nxt})

    def _set_text(qid, text):
        set_answers({**answers, qid: text})

    def _answered(q):
        v = _val(q["id"])
        if q["kind"] == "checkbox":
            return v is not None and len(v) > 0
        if q["kind"] == "text":
            return v is not None and v.strip() != ""
        return v is not None

    def _same_set(a, b):
        if len(a) != len(b):
            return False
        for x in a:
            if x not in b:
                return False
        return True

    def _correct(q):
        v = _val(q["id"])
        if q["kind"] == "checkbox":
            return _same_set(v if v is not None else [], q["answer"])
        if q["kind"] == "text":
            return (v if v is not None else "").strip().lower() == q["answer"].lower()
        return v == q["answer"]

    def _submit():
        missing = [q["id"] for q in QUIZ["questions"] if not _answered(q)]
        set_errors(missing)
        if len(missing) == 0:
            set_submitted(True)

    def _retake():
        set_answers({})
        set_errors([])
        set_submitted(False)

    if submitted:
        score = len([q for q in QUIZ["questions"] if _correct(q)])
        return div(
            class_name="cx-quiz",
            data_testid="quiz-score",
            h3(
                data_testid="quiz-score-line",
                "You scored " + str(score) + "/" + str(len(QUIZ["questions"])),
            ),
            ul(
                class_name="cx-review",
                *[
                    li(
                        key=q["id"],
                        data_testid="quiz-review-" + q["id"],
                        data_correct=_correct(q),
                        ("Correct: " if _correct(q) else "Incorrect: ") + q["prompt"],
                    )
                    for q in QUIZ["questions"]
                ],
            ),
            button(class_name="cx-btn", data_testid="quiz-retake", on_click=_retake, "Retake quiz"),
        )

    return div(
        class_name="cx-quiz",
        data_testid="quiz",
        *[
            fieldset(
                key=q["id"],
                class_name="cx-q",
                data_testid="quiz-q-" + q["id"],
                legend(str(idx + 1) + ". " + q["prompt"]),
                q["kind"] == "radio" and [
                    label(
                        key=opt,
                        class_name="cx-opt",
                        input(
                            type="radio",
                            name=q["id"],
                            value=opt,
                            checked=_val(q["id"]) == opt,
                            on_change=lambda: _set_radio(q["id"], opt),
                        ),
                        opt,
                    )
                    for opt in q["options"]
                ],
                q["kind"] == "checkbox" and [
                    label(
                        key=opt,
                        class_name="cx-opt",
                        input(
                            type="checkbox",
                            name=q["id"],
                            value=opt,
                            checked=_val(q["id"]) is not None and opt in _val(q["id"]),
                            on_change=lambda: _toggle_check(q["id"], opt),
                        ),
                        opt,
                    )
                    for opt in q["options"]
                ],
                q["kind"] == "text" and input(
                    class_name="cx-text-answer",
                    data_testid="quiz-text-" + q["id"],
                    type="text",
                    placeholder="Your answer",
                    value=_val(q["id"]) if _val(q["id"]) is not None else "",
                    on_change=lambda e: _set_text(q["id"], e.target.value),
                ),
                q["id"] in errors and p(
                    class_name="cx-q-err",
                    data_testid="quiz-q-err-" + q["id"],
                    "Please answer this question.",
                ),
            )
            for idx, q in enumerate(QUIZ["questions"])
        ],
        len(errors) > 0 and p(
            class_name="cx-quiz-err",
            data_testid="quiz-error",
            "Answer all questions before submitting.",
        ),
        div(
            class_name="cx-quiz-actions",
            button(class_name="cx-btn", data_testid="quiz-submit", on_click=_submit, "Submit quiz"),
            button(
                class_name="cx-devcrash",
                data_testid="quiz-crash-dev",
                aria_hidden="true",
                tab_index=-1,
                on_click=lambda: set_crashed(True),
                "dev: crash quiz",
            ),
        ),
    )


@psx
def _quiz_fallback(on_reload):

        class_name="cx-quiz-fallback",

# The A3 exercise: a PythScribe class component extending React's native
# Component base. Native-constructor emission (no cooperative PyObject MRO
# wrap) is what keeps `self.state` alive here - see pyths_codegen_js
# test_class_extending_external_base_uses_native_constructor.
class QuizBoundary(Component):
    def __init__(self, props):
        super().__init__(props)
        self.state = {"hasError": False}

    @staticmethod
    def getDerivedStateFromError(error):
        return {"hasError": True}

    def componentDidCatch(self, error, info):
        pass

    def render(self):
        if self.state["hasError"]:
            return _quiz_fallback(lambda: self.setState({"hasError": False}))
        return self.props.children

        h2("Syllabus"),
        div(
            class_name="cx-weeks",
            *[
                div(
                    key=str(i),
                    class_name="cx-week",
                    data_testid="week-" + str(i),
                    div(
                        class_name="cx-week-head",
                        button(
                            class_name="cx-week-toggle",

                        class_name="cx-lessons",

                    ),
                )
                for i, w in enumerate(course["weeks"])
            ],
        ),
        h2(QUIZ["title"]),
        QuizBoundary(Quiz()),
    )


@component
def CourseraApp():
    selected_id, set_selected_id = use_state(None)
    matches = [c for c in COURSES if c["id"] == selected_id]
    course = matches[0] if len(matches) > 0 else None
    return div(
        class_name="cx-app",
        data_testid="coursera-app",
        header(
            class_name="cx-header",
            span(class_name="cx-logo", "coursera"),
            span(class_name="cx-tagline", "clone demo"),
        ),
        Catalog(on_select=set_selected_id)
        if course is None
        else CourseDetail(course=course, on_back=lambda: set_selected_id(None)),
    )

def next_card_id(columns):

        for card in col["cards"]:
            v = int(card["id"][1:])
            if v > n:
                n = v
    return "c" + str(n + 1)


def next_col_id(columns):
    n = 0
    for col in columns:
        v = int(col["id"][3:])

# hovered column id plus the insertion index among that column's cards

    cards = col_el.querySelectorAll("[data-card-id]")

            if c["id"] == card_id:

        return columns
    without = [{**col, "cards": [c for c in col["cards"] if c["id"] != card_id]} for col in columns]

def KanbanBoard():
    columns, set_columns = use_state(lambda: structuredClone(KANBAN_FIXTURE))
    drag, set_drag = use_state(None)
    editing, set_editing = use_state(None)
    composing, set_composing = use_state(None)
    compose_text, set_compose_text = use_state("")
    renaming, set_renaming = use_state(None)
    rename_text, set_rename_text = use_state("")
    adding_col, set_adding_col = use_state(False)
    new_col_text, set_new_col_text = use_state("")
    did_drag_ref = use_ref(False)

    # localStorage persistence - load once after mount (client-only, so the
    # Next SSR pass and hydration both render the fixtures). Saving is
    # WRITE-THROUGH at each mutation site (update_board) rather than a
    # [columns]-effect: a save-effect's mount run closes over the initial
    # fixtures and clobbers the saved board before the load's re-render
    # lands (guaranteed under StrictMode's double-effect pass).
    def _load():
        try:
            raw = localStorage.getItem(KANBAN_STORAGE_KEY)
            if raw is not None:

                if Array.isArray(saved):
                    set_columns(saved)
        except Exception:
            pass

    use_effect(_load, [])

        localStorage.setItem(KANBAN_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next_columns))

    # per state change (deps) - cheap, and keeps the handlers closure-fresh.

            return lambda: None

                dx = e.clientX - drag["start_x"]
                dy = e.clientY - drag["start_y"]
                if dx * dx + dy * dy < 25:
                    return
                did_drag_ref.current = True
            e.preventDefault()
            over_col, over_index = hit_test(e.clientX, e.clientY, drag["card_id"])
            set_drag({**drag, "active": True, "x": e.clientX, "y": e.clientY, "over_col": over_col, "over_index": over_index})

        def on_up(e):
            if drag["active"] and drag["over_col"] is not None:
                update_board(move_card(columns, drag["card_id"], drag["over_col"], drag["over_index"]))

        def on_key(e):
            if e.key == "Escape":
                set_drag(None)

        window.addEventListener("pointermove", on_move)
        window.addEventListener("pointerup", on_up)
        window.addEventListener("keydown", on_key)

        def _cleanup():
            window.removeEventListener("pointermove", on_move)
            window.removeEventListener("pointerup", on_up)
            window.removeEventListener("keydown", on_key)

        update_board([{**col, "cards": [c for c in col["cards"] if c["id"] != card_id]} for col in columns])

        if not text:
            return

        set_compose_text("")

        if e.key == "Enter" and not e.shiftKey:
            e.preventDefault()
            add_card(col_id)
        elif e.key == "Escape":
            set_composing(None)
            set_compose_text("")

    def start_rename(col):
        set_renaming(col["id"])
        set_rename_text(col["title"])

    def save_rename():
        text = rename_text.strip()
        if text:
            update_board([{**col, "title": text} if col["id"] == renaming else col for col in columns])
        set_renaming(None)

    def on_rename_key(e):
        if e.key == "Enter":
            e.preventDefault()
            save_rename()
        elif e.key == "Escape":
            set_renaming(None)

    def add_column():
        text = new_col_text.strip()
        if not text:
            return
        update_board([*columns, {"id": next_col_id(columns), "title": text, "cards": []}])
        set_new_col_text("")
        set_adding_col(False)

    def on_new_col_key(e):
        if e.key == "Enter":
            e.preventDefault()
            add_column()
        elif e.key == "Escape":
            set_adding_col(False)
            set_new_col_text("")

    def _cancel_compose():
        set_composing(None)
        set_compose_text("")

    def _open_compose(col_id):
        set_composing(col_id)
        set_compose_text("")

    def _cancel_new_col():
        set_adding_col(False)
        set_new_col_text("")

    def reset_board():
        update_board(structuredClone(KANBAN_FIXTURE))
        set_drag(None)
        set_editing(None)
        set_composing(None)
        set_compose_text("")
        set_renaming(None)
        set_adding_col(False)
        set_new_col_text("")

        class_name="kb-board" + (" kb-board--dragging" if drag is not None and drag["active"] else ""),
        data_testid="kanban-board",
        div(
            class_name="kb-toolbar",
            h1(class_name="kb-title", "Kanban"),
            button(class_name="kb-reset", data_testid="kb-reset", on_click=reset_board, "Reset board"),
        ),
        div(
            class_name="kb-cols",
            data_testid="kb-cols",
            [
                section(
                    key=col["id"],
                    class_name="kb-col" + (" kb-col--drop" if drag is not None and drag["active"] and drag["over_col"] == col["id"] else ""),
                    data_col_id=col["id"],
                    data_testid="kb-col-" + col["id"],
                    header(
                        class_name="kb-col-head",
                        input(
                            class_name="kb-rename",
                            data_testid="kb-rename-input",
                            value=rename_text,
                            auto_focus=True,
                            on_change=lambda e: set_rename_text(e.target.value),
                            on_key_down=on_rename_key,
                        ) if renaming == col["id"] else h2(
                            class_name="kb-col-title",
                            data_testid="kb-col-title-" + col["id"],
                            on_click=lambda: start_rename(col),
                            col["title"],
                        ),
                        span(class_name="kb-count", data_testid="kb-count-" + col["id"], len(col["cards"])),
                    ),
                    div(
                        class_name="kb-cards",
                        [
                            div(
                                key=card["id"],
                                class_name="kb-card kb-card--editing",
                                data_card_id=card["id"],
                                textarea(
                                    class_name="kb-edit",
                                    data_testid="kb-edit-input",
                                    value=editing["text"],
                                    auto_focus=True,

# Deliberate stdlib exercise: fixture offsets -> timedelta via datetime
# subtraction. Mirrors relative_time in TwitterApp.tsx exactly ("now",
# "2m", "3h", "1d" buckets, truncating division).
def relative_time(created_ts, now_ts):

    overrides, set_overrides = use_state({})
    count, set_count = use_state(BATCH)
    view, set_view = use_state(None)
    toast, set_toast = use_state(None)
    sentinel = use_ref(None)
    next_id = use_ref(1)

    all_tweets = [*extra, *tweets]
    feed = [t for t in all_tweets if not t.replyTo]
    visible = feed[:count]
    has_more = count < len(feed)

    def setup_observer():
        # bare return (undefined), NOT `return None`: React 19 rejects a
        # null effect cleanup ("destroy is not a function" at unmount)
        if not window.IntersectionObserver:
            return

        def on_intersect(entries, obs):
            if entries[0].isIntersecting:
                set_count(lambda c: c + BATCH)

        obs = IntersectionObserver(on_intersect, {"rootMargin": "200px"})
        if sentinel.current:
            obs.observe(sentinel.current)
        return lambda: obs.disconnect()

    use_effect(setup_observer, [count, view])

    def show_toast(msg):
        set_toast(msg)
        setTimeout(lambda: set_toast(None), TOAST_MS)

    def effective(t):
        o = overrides.get(t.id) or {}
        return {
            "liked": o.get("liked", False),
            "retweeted": o.get("retweeted", False),
            "likes": o.get("likes", t.likes),
            "retweets": o.get("retweets", t.retweets),
        }

    def set_override(tid, patch):
        set_overrides(lambda o: {**o, tid: {**(o.get(tid) or {}), **patch}})

    def count_replies(tid):
        return len([x for x in all_tweets if x.replyTo == tid])

    def post_tweet(text):
        tid = f"local-{next_id.current}"
        next_id.current += 1
        t = {
            "id": tid,
            "author": me,
            "text": text,
            "ts": now_ts,
            "likes": 0,
            "retweets": 0,
            "replyTo": None,
            "pending": True,
        }
        set_extra(lambda xs: [t, *xs])

        async def send():
            try:
                await send_tweet(text)
                set_extra(
                    lambda xs: [
                        {**x, "pending": False} if x.id == tid else x for x in xs
                    ]
                )
            except PostFailedError:
                set_extra(lambda xs: [x for x in xs if x.id != tid])
                show_toast("Post failed — rolled back")

        delta = 1 if retweeted else -1
        set_override(t.id, {"retweeted": retweeted, "retweets": eff.retweets + delta})
        if retweeted and "#fail" in t.text:

            def rollback():
                set_override(t.id, {"retweeted": eff.retweeted, "retweets": eff.retweets})
                show_toast("Retweet failed — rolled back")

            setTimeout(rollback, SEND_MS)

    def open_thread(t):

    body = None
    if view is None:
        body = main(
            class_name="tw-feed",
            data_testid="feed",
            ComposeBox(on_post=post_tweet),
            *[
                TweetCard(

                    on_rt=toggle_rt,

                for t in visible
            ],
            has_more
            and div(class_name="tw-sentinel", data_testid="feed-sentinel", ref=sentinel),
            div(
                class_name="tw-feed-status",
                data_testid="feed-count",
                len(visible),
                " of ",
                len(feed),
            ),
        )
    else:
        parent_matches = [x for x in all_tweets if x.id == view]
        parent = parent_matches[0] if len(parent_matches) > 0 else None
        replies = [x for x in all_tweets if x.replyTo == view]
        body = section(
            class_name="tw-thread",
            data_testid="thread",
            button(
                class_name="tw-back",
                data_testid="thread-back",
                on_click=lambda: set_view(None),
                "← Back",
            ),
            parent
            and TweetCard(
                t=parent,
                eff=effective(parent),
                reply_count=len(replies),
                now_ts=now_ts,
                on_open=open_thread,
                on_like=toggle_like,
                on_rt=toggle_rt,
            ),
            h2(class_name="tw-thread-title", "Replies (", len(replies), ")"),
            *[
                TweetCard(
                    key=t.id,
                    t=t,
                    eff=effective(t),
                    reply_count=count_replies(t.id),
                    now_ts=now_ts,
                    on_open=open_thread,
                    on_like=toggle_like,
                    on_rt=toggle_rt,
                )
                for t in replies
            ],
            len(replies) == 0 and p(class_name="tw-no-replies", "No replies yet."),
        )

    return div(
        class_name="tw-app",
        data_testid="twitter-app",
        header(class_name="tw-header", h1("Chirper")),
        toast and div(class_name="tw-toast", data_testid="toast", role="status", toast),

    )

                    span(cn="yt-time", data_testid="yt-time", f"{fmt_time(current_time)} / {fmt_time(duration)}"),
                ),
                h1(cn="yt-watch-title", data_testid="yt-watch-title", item["title"]),
                div(
                    cn="yt-channel-row",
                    div(cn="yt-avatar", st={"background": item["color"]}, item["channel"][0]),
                    div(
                        cn="yt-channel-info",
                        p(cn="yt-channel", item["channel"]),
                        p(cn="yt-stats", f"{item['views']} views • {item['age']}"),
                    ),
                    button(
                        cn="yt-subscribe" + (" subscribed" if subscribed else ""),
                        data_testid="yt-subscribe",
                        oc=lambda: on_toggle_subscribe(item["channel"]),
                        "Subscribed" if subscribed else "Subscribe",
                    ),
                ),
            ),
            aside(
                cn="yt-related",
                data_testid="yt-related",
                h2(cn="yt-related-heading", "Up next"),
                *[
                    div(
                        key=v["id"],
                        cn="yt-related-item",
                        data_testid="yt-related-item",
                        oc=lambda: on_open(v),
                        div(cn="yt-related-thumb", st={"backgroundImage": f"url({v['thumb']})", "backgroundSize": "cover", "backgroundColor": v["color"]}, span(cn="yt-duration", v["duration"])),
                        div(
                            cn="yt-related-meta",
                            p(cn="yt-related-title", v["title"]),
                            p(cn="yt-related-channel", v["channel"]),
                        ),
                    )
                    for v in related
                ],
            ),
        ),
    )


@c
def YouTubeApp(videos):
    query, set_query = us("")
    current, set_current = us(None)
    subscribed_channels, set_subscribed_channels = us([])

    filtered = um(
        lambda: videos.filter(
            lambda v: v["title"].toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
            or v["channel"].toLowerCase().includes(query.toLowerCase())
        ),
        [videos, query],
    )

    def handle_query(q):
        set_query(q)
        set_current(None)

    def open_video(v):
        set_current(v)

    def toggle_subscribe(channel):
        if subscribed_channels.includes(channel):
            set_subscribed_channels(subscribed_channels.filter(lambda c: c != channel))
        else:
            set_subscribed_channels([*subscribed_channels, channel])

    related = videos.filter(lambda v: v["id"] != current["id"]).slice(0, 10) if current else []

    return div(
        cn="yt-app",
        data_testid="yt-app",
        SearchHeader(query=query, on_change=handle_query),
        WatchView(
            key=current["id"],
            item=current,
            related=related,
            subscribed=subscribed_channels.includes(current["channel"]),
            on_toggle_subscribe=toggle_subscribe,
            on_open=open_video,
            on_back=lambda: set_current(None),
        ) if current else VideoFeed(videos=filtered, on_open=open_video),
    )


__default__ = YouTubeApp
